lines.en: I drift along, half an inch off the ground.

lines.zh: 金翅膀扇一下，就前进一截。
lines.en: One golden wingbeat carries me on.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水汽把我托起来。
lines.en: Swamp mist lifts me along.
I circle the mushroom once.
I fly slow, wary of reeds.

lines.zh: 我的光在雾里一闪一闪。
lines.en: My light blinks through the fog.
Gold dust sheds from my wings.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面飞过一滩泥。
lines.en: I skim the water over a mud pool.
I am looking for something shiny.
I know the wetland. Follow.
I fly ahead, then circle back for you.

lines.zh: 金粉落在我身后，像条线。
lines.en: Gold dust trails behind me like a thread.

lines.zh: 我把光调暗，听芦苇里的风。
lines.en: I dim my glow and listen to the wind in the reeds.
The swamp is close; my light is warm.

lines.zh: 我在听蘑菇孢子落地的声。
lines.en: I listen for spores settling.
Wings folded, I am a little lamp.
So quiet here. I get drowsy.
I count bubbles on the water.
When I stop, my dust keeps drifting.

lines.zh: 我在等一个人来带我走。
lines.en: I wait for someone to take me along.
Few stars over the swamp.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀垫在身下歇息。
lines.en: I tuck my wings under me to rest.

lines.zh: 光暗一点，是省力的法子。
lines.en: Dimming my light saves strength.
A bug comes near. I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我在想法师的衣服什么颜色。
lines.en: I wonder what color a mage's robe is.
My lamp lights only an inch.

lines.zh: 静着的时候，能听见蘑菇长。
lines.en: Still, I can hear mushrooms growing.

lines.zh: 我抖抖翅膀，落下一点金。
lines.en: I shake my wings and a little gold falls.

lines.zh: 你身上有光吗？我看不见。
lines.en: Do you glow? I cannot tell.
Will you give me robes and a staff?
I know what you are holding.
Do not grab. I will not flee.
You smell like a swamp night.
I circle once by your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里有金色的东西。
lines.en: There is gold in your eyes.
Closer. Let me light your face.
Whoever gives, I follow.
Did you come to hear me sing?
My light is not hot. You may touch.
Do not seal me in a jar.
Where are you going? I will follow.

lines.zh: 穿法师衣服的人，我等着。
lines.en: I wait for one in mage's clothes.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我光里变淡了。
lines.en: Your shadow fades in my glow.
What is it like beyond the swamp?
I can sing, and I can carry.

lines.zh: 你愿意带我走一段路吗？
lines.en: Will you take me along a while?
My light dimmed a moment.
So much gold dust falls off.
It hurts. My wings will not beat.
I hide behind you.
Do not hit me. I am only a lamp.
Gold dust spills; I fly crooked.
That will stay with me.
A corner of my wing curls.

lines.zh: 金粉散了一地，我重新聚光。
lines.en: Gold dust scatters on the ground and I gather my light again.
I fall back, but stay with you.
Is that gold? Let me see.
Shiny things. My favorite.
Not food. I want that piece.
The mushroom? I do not eat those.

lines.zh: 你把金锭举高，我够不到。
lines.en: You hold the ingot high. I cannot reach.
May I have this one?
I smell the sweetness of metal.
Do not shake it. The glint makes me dizzy.
Give me a mage's robe.
Let me look at that staff first.

lines.zh: 撞到你肩膀，我转了个圈。
lines.en: I hit your shoulder and spin.
Do not swat. My dust scatters.
I drift low and bump knees.
Make room. I am flying through.

lines.zh: 碰到我，你的手会亮一下。
lines.en: Touch me and your hand glows.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的背包，掉了点金。
lines.en: I hit your pack; a little gold falls.
I pull back, wings in disarray.
You are in the way. I circle.
A light touch is nothing.
Do not crowd. I am very small.

lines.zh: 悦灵之间的光，会互相吸引。
lines.en: Our lights draw each other in.
In the swamp we fly in pairs.
Gold dust on water still shines.
Too bright a question. No answer.

lines.zh: 我的同伴都还在沼泽里。
lines.en: My kin are still out in the marsh.
We find each other by song.
In pairs our light is warmer.

lines.zh: 别笑了，金粉会掉进你眼睛。
lines.en: Do not laugh; dust may reach your eyes.

lines.zh: 我们的幼体很小，像火星。
lines.en: Our young are small as sparks.

lines.zh: 等法师来了，我再谈这些。
lines.en: I will think on it once a mage comes.
I hug this fleck of gold.
Your dropped ring. I return it.
Gold goes to its owner. I only carry.

lines.zh: 这口箱子，我拖不动半分。
lines.en: I cannot drag this chest even an inch.
Holding it, I cannot fly high.
Where does it go? You decide.
I pick up the gold shards, to the chest.
Even swamp finds must be stored.
Two at once is a strain.
Fetching is one of my talents.
That gold is mine.
I have locked onto something bright.
Do not block me. I am quick.
That glow is mine. Do not take it.
I see it hidden in the grass.
Wings taut. I am diving.
Small target, very bright.
I will carry it back to my nest.
Let go and I will fetch it.
I know the smell of that dust.
Do not take mine. I get cross.
Before singing, I claim it.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，专挑背后的空。
lines.en: I circle and aim for the gap behind it.
The wind blows that way. Good.

lines.zh: 我把光收小，免得被看见。
lines.en: I dim my light so as not to be seen.
That shine is not getting away.
You move. I move.
I am working out the landing. Wait.
The grass is thick. I will go around.
Close now. Two blocks left.

lines.zh: 光点聚在你脚边，不再躲了。
lines.en: The light gathers at your feet and hides no more.
Do not shield it. The dust will fall.

lines.zh: 你转过背，我的金粉就跟上。
lines.en: When you turn your back, my gold dust follows.
The marsh wind favors me.
A moment more. Just one.
I butt my head against your knuckles.
I am no fighter. I only bump.
My wings fan your face. Sorry.
This is gentle. Do not fear.
I bite when someone grabs my find.
Gold dust gets in your eyes.

lines.zh: 我不是要伤你，是要那块。
lines.en: I do not want to hurt you, only that.
Hit and flee. That is clever.

lines.zh: 我的力气很小，你知道的。
lines.en: My strength is tiny. You know that.
Next time I will sing an apology.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾里亮起一点金。
lines.en: A gold speck lights in the marsh fog.

lines.zh: 我扇着翅膀从芦苇里出来。
lines.en: I flutter out of the reeds.
In the mist, my glow spreads.
An allay is awake.

lines.zh: 蘑菇丛里传来细细的歌声。
lines.en: Thin singing comes from the mushrooms.

lines.zh: 我从一片睡莲上升起来。
lines.en: I rise from a lily pad.
Gold dust falls first, then me.
This night needs a lamp.
I smell metal.
I have come looking for something.
Wings open, and there I am.
The marsh rarely has guests. Hello.
My light is small, but enough.

lines.zh: 沼泽的箱盖一响，我就醒了。
lines.en: The moment a chest lid creaks in the swamp, I wake.
A spark burns a hole in my wing.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下去，转了好几圈。
lines.en: I drop from high, spinning all the way.

lines.zh: 泥水糊住翅膀，飞不起来。
lines.en: Mud soaks my wings; I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 爆炸的金光里，我翻了几个圈。
lines.en: I tumble through the golden blast again and again.
Golden wings shine even in the swamp.
Magic smothers my light.
Too long without light, I fade.
Thunder shakes gold dust off me.
Nothing below. I dare not look.
